title: Warm Baked Cinnamon Oat-Stuffed Apples
hookLine: Tender caramelized apples stuffed with toasted oats, pecans, cinnamon & a drizzle of warm raw honey.

items.name: Rolled oats + chopped pecans + 1 tsp cinnamon
Pure maple or raw honey + 1 tsp coconut oil

steps.title: Preheat Air Fryer & Measure Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your air fryer to 330°F (165°C) for 3 minutes and line the basket with perforated parchment or a light oil mist. Measure out {ba_app} and {ba_oat} in a mixing bowl so they combine evenly.

steps.title: Stuff Apples & Air Fry 18 Mins
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix {ba_oat} and {ba_hon}, pack into {ba_app}, and air-fry at 350°F (175°C) for 18–20 minutes until fork-tender and bubbling. Plate into 2 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.creatorSecret: Top with a spoonful of cold Greek yogurt for warm-meets-cold apple pie vibes.

steps.title: Bake Warm Baked Cinnamon Oat-Stuffed Apples & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 20 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Rest 5 Minutes & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Carefully lift Warm Baked Cinnamon Oat-Stuffed Apples out of the air-fryer basket and rest 5 minutes on a cooling rack so the crust crisps up. Plate into 2 servings and enjoy warm.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 170 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
